name: Luban S2
summary: Luban S2 is XBO Intelligence’s mobile dual-arm humanoid for inspection and manipulation. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base with a lifting column, sensor head, articulated arms and hands. The manufacturer describes obstacle avoidance, route planning and grasping tasks, with intended uses including production-line inspection, sorting, handling and security patrol. It is publicly documented in the official catalog; current delivery availability has not been verified.
